author: Pelpelajax
body:
Hello, just a simple suggestion.

So, as you know we have maximum team sizes. Some one with a Premium Rank, can join full teams. But, to stop games from going over their capacity, and becoming chaotic, it think we should add something, called, Capacity. This would mean that after a game has reached a total amount of players, anyhwere between 10-25% of its original size, no one can join anymore, including people with Premium Ranks. Just to stop the game from becoming chaotic. Teams with max sizes of 30, wouldn't have any players join when it has 33 to 38 players. Opinions, ideas?

title: [SUG] Add "Capacity"

replies.author: Notalgicular
replies.body: I don't think this is to big of an issue right now, but as the player count rises, this may be needed
replies.body_tagged: I don't think this is to big of an issue right now, but as the player count rises, this may be needed

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
I would far rather play a match that's overcrowded, than not play at all.

I can see where you're coming from, but it defeats the object of donator perks. I see games with over 10 players than the original amount, but I can still play and not get crowded every minute.

If it's over by 25 players, then I think we could consider it.

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body: I like the idea, having a set limit.  However, when a game is full, when donors join, they kick a regular user.  This will force other users to create their own game, so they actually uses the other servers.  If no one uses any of the other servers ( ex: 1 massive MCZone game ) what is the point of having other Nebula servers.
